flows.title: Find a person's email with Email Finder
steps: Enter the first and last name of the person you are looking to find the email address for.
Enter the domain name, website, or company name this person works for.

Read the result: the email address comes with its sources and its verification status, and is saved to the Leads list automatically. If no email is found, click See results for [domain] to see the domain's other addresses in Domain Search.

flows.title: Verify an email address
steps: Select the "Verifier" tool in the left-side navigation panel.
Enter the email address you'd like to verify.
Click the "Verify" button to run the Email Verifier.
Review the result: green means the email is valid and safe to send to, yellow means it's on an accept-all domain whose deliverability can't be guaranteed, and red means it was verified as invalid.

flows.title: Find companies with Discover
steps: Access Discover from the main menu in your Hunter dashboard, or go directly to hunter.io/discover.

Use the AI Assistant by typing a plain-language description of your target audience (for example, "SaaS companies with 50-200 employees in Europe") and clicking the orange button, or apply filters manually from the sidebar instead.
Click any company in your results to expand its profile, showing its description, industry and size, headquarters location, and detected technologies.
